speed_buff_toggle.title: Speed Buff Toggle
speed_buff_toggle.description: Toggle a burst of speed and agility
commands: effect give @s minecraft:speed 10 2 true
effect give @s minecraft:jump_boost 10 1 true
execute at @s run particle minecraft:electric_spark ~ ~0.5 ~ 0.6 0.6 0.6 0.2 25
execute at @s run particle minecraft:sonic_boom ~ ~1 ~ 0 0 0 0 1
execute at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.wither.shoot player @a ~ ~ ~ 0.8 1.6

plasma_fist.title: Plasma Fist
plasma_fist.description: Left Click: Strike with energized lightning knockback
commands: execute at @s run particle minecraft:electric_spark ~ ~1 ~ 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.08 20
execute as @e[type=!minecraft:player,distance=..4] at @s run damage @s 6 minecraft:lightning_bolt
execute as @e[type=!minecraft:player,distance=..4] at @s run tp @s ^ ^ ^-2
execute at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.lightning_bolt.impact player @a ~ ~ ~ 0.5 1.8

plasma_wave.title: Plasma Wave
plasma_wave.description: Z: Discharge a pulsing plasma wave that slows and repels enemies
commands: execute at @s run particle minecraft:electric_spark ~ ~1 ~ 2 2 2 0.1 60
execute at @s run particle minecraft:flame ~ ~1 ~ 1.5 1.5 1.5 0.05 30
execute at @s run particle minecraft:sonic_boom ~ ~1 ~ 0 0 0 0 1
execute at @s as @e[type=!minecraft:player,distance=..10] at @s run tp @s ^ ^ ^-2
execute at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,distance=..10] minecraft:slowness 4 2 true
execute at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.lightning_bolt.thunder player @a ~ ~ ~ 0.7 1.2
execute at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.generic.explode player @a ~ ~ ~ 0.5 0.8

electric_overload.title: Electric Overload
electric_overload.description: V: Discharge power to knockback and blind nearby enemies
commands: execute as @a[distance=..1,limit=1] at @s run particle minecraft:electric_spark ~ ~1 ~ 1.5 1.5 1.5 0.12 150
execute as @a[distance=..1,limit=1] at @s run effect give @e[type=!minecraft:player,distance=..8] minecraft:blindness 3 1 true
execute as @a[distance=..1,limit=1] at @s as @e[type=!minecraft:player,distance=..8] at @s run tp @s ^ ^ ^-1.5
execute as @a[distance=..1,limit=1] at @s run playsound minecraft:entity.lightning_bolt.thunder player @a ~ ~ ~ 0.5 1.2
